text:
jordan: quick idea after skimming the postmortem: create a short 'closure sprintlet' for remediations (2 weeks) with explicit owners and a tiny timeline card. want to pilot?

emily: yes. make the card mandatory in the PM checklist. otherwise items drift.

noah: propose fields: owner, contact, due, impact, acceptance, recurrence_tag, recurrence_count. keep one-line entries so people actually fill them.

tara: escalation suggestion: no movement in 48h -> assign to secondary; no movement in 7d -> notify lead and add to next sprint triage. keeps things from aging.

oncall-bot: FYI: ack reminders can be automated via /incidents webhook if cards link to incident ids.

jordan: pilot plan:
- week 0: require card on new remediations + owners filled
- weeks 1-2: run closure sprintlet; weekly 20m sync to clear blockers
- after 2 weeks: measure closed_count and avg_time_to_plan, iterate

emily: add recurrence heatmap to weekly ops notes so we can flag systemic problems.

noah: IC rotation tweak: weekly IC but add a 2-week follow-up owner who carries remediations to completion. reduces handoff churn.

tara: i'll update the postmortem checklist pr with the card template today.

jordan: i'll schedule the first 20m sync for next Tue and create a GH project board.

oncall-bot: Reminder created: "closure-sprintlet kickoff" in 3 days (participants: jordan, emily, noah, tara).
